jobTitle: Business Analytics Sr. Specialist/Manager (Flight)(MJ037010)
requirements:
About the role

We are looking for a Commercial Analytics Sr. Specialist / Manager to join our Overseas Flight Business team.


This is a hands-on role working closely with commercial teams across markets. You will help business stakeholders turn complex business questions and data into clear insights, structured analytical approaches, and practical solutions that support better and faster decision-making.


You will also work closely with our central BI and data teams to ensure that business needs are translated into scalable data and analytical solutions, while keeping a strong focus on business impact and usability.


- Commercial and strategic analytics: Partner with business stakeholders to identify key business questions, develop analytical frameworks, and provide insights on commercial performance, opportunities, and challenges across markets.

- Commercial asset analytics: Develop data and measurement frameworks to evaluate the value, utilisation, and business impact of key commercial assets, and help the business identify opportunities to improve their acquisition, deployment, and effectiveness.

- Decision-support tools and solutions: Translate recurring analytical needs and business strategies into practical tools, workflows, and decision-support solutions that can be embedded into the daily working process of commercial teams.

- Data and AI-enabled analytics: Explore and apply new data and AI capabilities to improve how commercial teams access information, perform analysis, and act on insights. Work with relevant data and BI specialists to turn promising use cases into reliable and reusable analytical solutions.

- Cross-functional collaboration: Work closely with commercial stakeholders, BI/data teams, and other functions to define requirements, align analytical logic and metrics, and ensure that solutions are both analytically sound and relevant to real business needs.

The role combines business understanding, analytical thinking, and practical execution. You will be expected not only to identify what the data says, but also to understand what it means for the business, what action it should enable, and how its impact can be measured.


Requirements

- 4–7 years of experience in management consulting, commercial strategy, revenue management, pricing, commercial analytics, decision science, operations research, quantitative analytics, or a similar role.

- Bachelor's degree in Business Analytics, Data Analytics, Economics, Finance or a related field.

- Experience in airline, travel, e-commerce, marketplace, hospitality, fintech, or other data-driven industries is a plus.

- Strong business acumen and the ability to translate ambiguous business problems into structured analytical questions and actionable insights.

- Strong data literacy and hands-on analytical skills; SQL proficiency is highly preferred.

- A systematic and structured mindset, with the ability to develop repeatable analytical approaches and solutions rather than relying on one-off analysis.

- Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with both commercial and technical teams.

- A strong sense of ownership and a results-oriented mindset, with the ability to connect analytical work to measurable business outcomes.

- Curiosity about AI and emerging data capabilities, and an ability to identify where they can meaningfully improve commercial analytics and business processes.

- Comfortable working in an international, fast-moving environment with a high degree of autonomy. English at business level is a must.

  • 精益运营与数据决策： 精通服务核心指标（一次解决率、服务满意度、人效AHT、低费力比等）的监控与提升逻辑，能够通过数据分析穿透问题本质；熟练使用常规分析模型和工具，为数据驱动的业务转型、降本提效提供决策支撑；

  • 创新驱动与体系化认证： 对OTA运营逻辑有深入理解，具有较强的流程优化和数字化/AI转型视野；具备具体项目管理经验（取得 PMP、六西格玛 6sigma 黑带/绿带）或质量管理体系认证者优先；
  • 语言能力： 具备熟练的英文听、说、读、写能力，可独立完成海外业务线或多语种协同的英文沟通及中高层工作汇报。

jobTitle: Business Analytics Sr. Specialist/Manager (Flight)(MJ037010)
requirements:
About the role

We are looking for a Commercial Analytics Sr. Specialist / Manager to join our Overseas Flight Business team.


This is a hands-on role working closely with commercial teams across markets. You will help business stakeholders turn complex business questions and data into clear insights, structured analytical approaches, and practical solutions that support better and faster decision-making.

- Data and AI-enabled analytics: Explore and apply new data and AI capabilities to improve how commercial teams access information, perform analysis, and act on insights. Work with relevant data and BI specialists to turn promising use cases into reliable and reusable analytical solutions.

- Cross-functional collaboration: Work closely with commercial stakeholders, BI/data teams, and other functions to define requirements, align analytical logic and metrics, and ensure that solutions are both analytically sound and relevant to real business needs.

The role combines business understanding, analytical thinking, and practical execution. You will be expected not only to identify what the data says, but also to understand what it means for the business, what action it should enable, and how its impact can be measured.

- Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with both commercial and technical teams.

- A strong sense of ownership and a results-oriented mindset, with the ability to connect analytical work to measurable business outcomes.

- Curiosity about AI and emerging data capabilities, and an ability to identify where they can meaningfully improve commercial analytics and business processes.

- Comfortable working in an international, fast-moving environment with a high degree of autonomy. English at business level is a must.

二、服务交付

  • 效能与质量双升（服务提升）： 负责核心指标攻坚。实施前后台单据精细化分层与精准路由策略（提升人工低费力比）；大力推进AI赋能，通过线上化SOP与AI智能助理（Copilot）辅助，切实缩短单均处理时长（AHT）；落实首问负责制，提升“到我为止率”及一次性解决率。
  • 高优客情精细打透（服务洞察）： 深入洞察用户需求，特别是聚焦核心高优用户（如黑钻客户）。针对跟团游、私家团（含微信等私域多触点）等复杂场景设定专属服务保障策略，全面提升大盘及高优客户满意度（CSAT），打造卓越的客情体验。
  • 逆向拦截与风控（风险管理）： 具备敏锐的全局视角，能够预见运营风险节点。总结客诉发生规律，从源头阻断客诉升级链路（降低升级率），进行前置风险预判和有效干预。

  • 产研业务深度协同： 高效对接流程、体验、产品、研发（产研）、QA及各业务闭环线。特别是能够作为业务一号位，与产研团队深度共建“AI坐席辅助系统”，将服务SOP与业务流转化为系统化、智能化能力，用技术赋能一线人员提升对客交付水平。


任职资格

  • 学历与专业背景： 本科及以上学历，管理学、旅游管理、市场营销、心理学等相关专业优先；
  • 行业与管理经验： 具备 5年以上 OTA 或大中型呼叫中心客服团队管理经验，精通自营、外包（BPO）及兼职等多维度复合用工模型的管理运营。除了传统的客服运营管理者，我们也极度欢迎具备产品经理（PM）背景的候选人。如果您曾主导过AI客服辅助系统、CRM平台、业务中台或复杂交易履约端的产品规划，擅长将复杂的业务诉求转化为系统SOP，且有意愿向“业务/运营一号位”转型，我们同样非常期待您的加入。
  • 精益运营与数据决策： 精通服务核心指标（一次解决率、服务满意度、人效AHT、低费力比等）的监控与提升逻辑，能够通过数据分析穿透问题本质；熟练使用常规分析模型和工具，为数据驱动的业务转型、降本提效提供决策支撑；

  • 语言能力： 具备熟练的英文听、说、读、写能力，可独立完成海外业务线或多语种协同的英文沟通及中高层工作汇报。

jobTitle: Business Analytics Sr. Specialist/Manager (Flight)(MJ037010)
requirements:
About the role

We are looking for a Commercial Analytics Sr. Specialist / Manager to join our Overseas Flight Business team.


This is a hands-on role working closely with commercial teams across markets. You will help business stakeholders turn complex business questions and data into clear insights, structured analytical approaches, and practical solutions that support better and faster decision-making.


You will also work closely with our central BI and data teams to ensure that business needs are translated into scalable data and analytical solutions, while keeping a strong focus on business impact and usability.


- Commercial and strategic analytics: Partner with business stakeholders to identify key business questions, develop analytical frameworks, and provide insights on commercial performance, opportunities, and challenges across markets.

- Commercial asset analytics: Develop data and measurement frameworks to evaluate the value, utilisation, and business impact of key commercial assets, and help the business identify opportunities to improve their acquisition, deployment, and effectiveness.

- Decision-support tools and solutions: Translate recurring analytical needs and business strategies into practical tools, workflows, and decision-support solutions that can be embedded into the daily working process of commercial teams.

- Data and AI-enabled analytics: Explore and apply new data and AI capabilities to improve how commercial teams access information, perform analysis, and act on insights. Work with relevant data and BI specialists to turn promising use cases into reliable and reusable analytical solutions.

- Cross-functional collaboration: Work closely with commercial stakeholders, BI/data teams, and other functions to define requirements, align analytical logic and metrics, and ensure that solutions are both analytically sound and relevant to real business needs.

The role combines business understanding, analytical thinking, and practical execution. You will be expected not only to identify what the data says, but also to understand what it means for the business, what action it should enable, and how its impact can be measured.


Requirements

- 4–7 years of experience in management consulting, commercial strategy, revenue management, pricing, commercial analytics, decision science, operations research, quantitative analytics, or a similar role.

- Bachelor's degree in Business Analytics, Data Analytics, Economics, Finance or a related field.

- Experience in airline, travel, e-commerce, marketplace, hospitality, fintech, or other data-driven industries is a plus.

- Strong business acumen and the ability to translate ambiguous business problems into structured analytical questions and actionable insights.

- Strong data literacy and hands-on analytical skills; SQL proficiency is highly preferred.

- A systematic and structured mindset, with the ability to develop repeatable analytical approaches and solutions rather than relying on one-off analysis.

- Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with both commercial and technical teams.

- A strong sense of ownership and a results-oriented mindset, with the ability to connect analytical work to measurable business outcomes.

- Curiosity about AI and emerging data capabilities, and an ability to identify where they can meaningfully improve commercial analytics and business processes.

- Comfortable working in an international, fast-moving environment with a high degree of autonomy. English at business level is a must.

jobTitle: Business Analytics Sr. Specialist/Manager (Flight)(MJ037010)
requirements:
About the role

We are looking for a Commercial Analytics Sr. Specialist / Manager to join our Overseas Flight Business team.


This is a hands-on role working closely with commercial teams across markets. You will help business stakeholders turn complex business questions and data into clear insights, structured analytical approaches, and practical solutions that support better and faster decision-making.


You will also work closely with our central BI and data teams to ensure that business needs are translated into scalable data and analytical solutions, while keeping a strong focus on business impact and usability.


- Commercial and strategic analytics: Partner with business stakeholders to identify key business questions, develop analytical frameworks, and provide insights on commercial performance, opportunities, and challenges across markets.

- Commercial asset analytics: Develop data and measurement frameworks to evaluate the value, utilisation, and business impact of key commercial assets, and help the business identify opportunities to improve their acquisition, deployment, and effectiveness.

- Decision-support tools and solutions: Translate recurring analytical needs and business strategies into practical tools, workflows, and decision-support solutions that can be embedded into the daily working process of commercial teams.

- Data and AI-enabled analytics: Explore and apply new data and AI capabilities to improve how commercial teams access information, perform analysis, and act on insights. Work with relevant data and BI specialists to turn promising use cases into reliable and reusable analytical solutions.

- Cross-functional collaboration: Work closely with commercial stakeholders, BI/data teams, and other functions to define requirements, align analytical logic and metrics, and ensure that solutions are both analytically sound and relevant to real business needs.

The role combines business understanding, analytical thinking, and practical execution. You will be expected not only to identify what the data says, but also to understand what it means for the business, what action it should enable, and how its impact can be measured.


Requirements

- 4–7 years of experience in management consulting, commercial strategy, revenue management, pricing, commercial analytics, decision science, operations research, quantitative analytics, or a similar role.

- Bachelor's degree in Business Analytics, Data Analytics, Economics, Finance or a related field.

- Experience in airline, travel, e-commerce, marketplace, hospitality, fintech, or other data-driven industries is a plus.

- Strong business acumen and the ability to translate ambiguous business problems into structured analytical questions and actionable insights.

- Strong data literacy and hands-on analytical skills; SQL proficiency is highly preferred.

- A systematic and structured mindset, with the ability to develop repeatable analytical approaches and solutions rather than relying on one-off analysis.

- Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with both commercial and technical teams.

- A strong sense of ownership and a results-oriented mindset, with the ability to connect analytical work to measurable business outcomes.

- Curiosity about AI and emerging data capabilities, and an ability to identify where they can meaningfully improve commercial analytics and business processes.

- Comfortable working in an international, fast-moving environment with a high degree of autonomy. English at business level is a must.

jobTitle: Business Analytics Sr. Specialist/Manager (Flight)(MJ037010)
requirements:
About the role

We are looking for a Commercial Analytics Sr. Specialist / Manager to join our Overseas Flight Business team.


This is a hands-on role working closely with commercial teams across markets. You will help business stakeholders turn complex business questions and data into clear insights, structured analytical approaches, and practical solutions that support better and faster decision-making.


You will also work closely with our central BI and data teams to ensure that business needs are translated into scalable data and analytical solutions, while keeping a strong focus on business impact and usability.


- Commercial and strategic analytics: Partner with business stakeholders to identify key business questions, develop analytical frameworks, and provide insights on commercial performance, opportunities, and challenges across markets.

- Commercial asset analytics: Develop data and measurement frameworks to evaluate the value, utilisation, and business impact of key commercial assets, and help the business identify opportunities to improve their acquisition, deployment, and effectiveness.

- Decision-support tools and solutions: Translate recurring analytical needs and business strategies into practical tools, workflows, and decision-support solutions that can be embedded into the daily working process of commercial teams.

- Data and AI-enabled analytics: Explore and apply new data and AI capabilities to improve how commercial teams access information, perform analysis, and act on insights. Work with relevant data and BI specialists to turn promising use cases into reliable and reusable analytical solutions.

- Cross-functional collaboration: Work closely with commercial stakeholders, BI/data teams, and other functions to define requirements, align analytical logic and metrics, and ensure that solutions are both analytically sound and relevant to real business needs.

The role combines business understanding, analytical thinking, and practical execution. You will be expected not only to identify what the data says, but also to understand what it means for the business, what action it should enable, and how its impact can be measured.


Requirements

- 4–7 years of experience in management consulting, commercial strategy, revenue management, pricing, commercial analytics, decision science, operations research, quantitative analytics, or a similar role.

- Bachelor's degree in Business Analytics, Data Analytics, Economics, Finance or a related field.

- Experience in airline, travel, e-commerce, marketplace, hospitality, fintech, or other data-driven industries is a plus.

- Strong business acumen and the ability to translate ambiguous business problems into structured analytical questions and actionable insights.

- Strong data literacy and hands-on analytical skills; SQL proficiency is highly preferred.

- A systematic and structured mindset, with the ability to develop repeatable analytical approaches and solutions rather than relying on one-off analysis.

- Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with both commercial and technical teams.

- A strong sense of ownership and a results-oriented mindset, with the ability to connect analytical work to measurable business outcomes.

- Curiosity about AI and emerging data capabilities, and an ability to identify where they can meaningfully improve commercial analytics and business processes.

- Comfortable working in an international, fast-moving environment with a high degree of autonomy. English at business level is a must.

jobTitle: 高级客服经理（度假售后）(MJ037012)
requirements:
职位描述

一、团队管理

  • 多维组织运营： 负责客服团队（涵盖自营、短期兼职、业务外包BPO）和业务的日常管理，建立并完善各岗位职责、团队配置、绩效考核与预警管理机制，保证服务体系稳定、可靠、高效地支撑业务需求。
  • 复合队伍与文化建设： 顺应人机协同趋势，培养具备“业务+AI调优”能力的复合型服务专家；塑造开放、协作的团队文化，深化组织关怀，有效提升团队凝聚力（NPS）并将流失率严控在健康水位。

二、服务交付

  • 效能与质量双升（服务提升）： 负责核心指标攻坚。实施前后台单据精细化分层与精准路由策略（提升人工低费力比）；大力推进AI赋能，通过线上化SOP与AI智能助理（Copilot）辅助，切实缩短单均处理时长（AHT）；落实首问负责制，提升“到我为止率”及一次性解决率。
  • 高优客情精细打透（服务洞察）： 深入洞察用户需求，特别是聚焦核心高优用户（如黑钻客户）。针对跟团游、私家团（含微信等私域多触点）等复杂场景设定专属服务保障策略，全面提升大盘及高优客户满意度（CSAT），打造卓越的客情体验。
  • 逆向拦截与风控（风险管理）： 具备敏锐的全局视角，能够预见运营风险节点。总结客诉发生规律，从源头阻断客诉升级链路（降低升级率），进行前置风险预判和有效干预。

三、跨团队协助

  • 产研业务深度协同： 高效对接流程、体验、产品、研发（产研）、QA及各业务闭环线。特别是能够作为业务一号位，与产研团队深度共建“AI坐席辅助系统”，将服务SOP与业务流转化为系统化、智能化能力，用技术赋能一线人员提升对客交付水平。


任职资格

  • 学历与专业背景： 本科及以上学历，管理学、旅游管理、市场营销、心理学等相关专业优先；
  • 行业与管理经验： 具备 5年以上 OTA 或大中型呼叫中心客服团队管理经验，精通自营、外包（BPO）及兼职等多维度复合用工模型的管理运营。除了传统的客服运营管理者，我们也极度欢迎具备产品经理（PM）背景的候选人。如果您曾主导过AI客服辅助系统、CRM平台、业务中台或复杂交易履约端的产品规划，擅长将复杂的业务诉求转化为系统SOP，且有意愿向“业务/运营一号位”转型，我们同样非常期待您的加入。
  • 精益运营与数据决策： 精通服务核心指标（一次解决率、服务满意度、人效AHT、低费力比等）的监控与提升逻辑，能够通过数据分析穿透问题本质；熟练使用常规分析模型和工具，为数据驱动的业务转型、降本提效提供决策支撑；
  • 全局风控与协作能力： 熟悉互联网呼叫中心的运作模式及相关用工法律法规，具备极强的风控及客诉危机应对能力；具备高效的跨团队（特别是跨产研、业务中台）沟通与资源协调能力；
  • 创新驱动与体系化认证： 对OTA运营逻辑有深入理解，具有较强的流程优化和数字化/AI转型视野；具备具体项目管理经验（取得 PMP、六西格玛 6sigma 黑带/绿带）或质量管理体系认证者优先；
  • 语言能力： 具备熟练的英文听、说、读、写能力，可独立完成海外业务线或多语种协同的英文沟通及中高层工作汇报。
